subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain this bounded retry as defense in depth if the shared reply-session self-heal also lands?
rationale: Both changes target the same conflict at different ownership layers; code review can establish correctness, but only maintainers can choose the intended permanent recovery policy and acceptable stacked retry behavior.

options.title: Shared recovery plus narrow retry
options.body: Use shared session recovery as canonical and retain this abort-aware Discord retry for transient conflict windows and replay-safe exhaustion.

options.title: Shared recovery only
options.body: Land the shared owner-layer repair and remove the Discord-specific retry if it fully prevents the observable message-loss path.

options.title: Discord recovery only
options.body: Keep recovery channel-local and do not adopt the broader shared self-heal for this conflict class.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery plus narrow retry
recommendation.body: Use shared session recovery as canonical and retain this abort-aware Discord retry for transient conflict windows and replay-safe exhaustion.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and the PR assignment connect this person most directly to both the Discord handler and adjacent session-lifecycle policy.
